_comment: monmove.c postmov() opens a closed door with the monster's hands when m_move()'s can_tunnel is false. A hostile dwarf close to the hero loses can_tunnel at monmove.c:1910-1914 although dwarves tunnel, so mon.c mfndpos() offers the closed door through OPENDOOR and postmov() opens it. The port's destination check used the species' tunnels() instead of m_move()'s can_tunnel and refused the move ('mfndpos() door or special terrain movement'). A debug-mode orcish Barbarian teleports to the corridor outside a closed door on level 1, creates a dwarf beside it, teleports just inside the door and waits until the dwarf opens it. Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
